brief:
The British government has suspended or rejected more than 80 export licenses to Israel for items that could be used by the Israeli military in the Gaza Strip, the Palestine News Network reported.

The suspensions and rejections affect licenses that had previously been approved, though no further details were immediately available on the types of equipment involved or the timeline for the action.
dek: LONDON /PNN / The British government has revealed that it has suspended or rejected more than 80 export licenses to Israel for items that could be used by the Israeli military in the Gaza Strip.
title: Britain suspends over 80 export licenses to Israel
